authority: Drawing identity and traceability registry. Runtime artifact paths/hashes are derived into evidence/immutable/ca53a873527cf19e76ac71a9c9089f707b121e9e5b93581e5f97b521e36ac6bd__K01_DRAWING_CONTROL_CURRENT.json.
rules: candidates/ is immutable build history; it is never the navigation entry point for routine work.
current/<drawing_id>/ is the stable current projection used by humans and Center.
No automatic deletion of candidates. Retention audit may mark archive eligibility only.
SLDDRW is linked to native 3D through the drawing-system spec/model path; PDF is a derivative, never authority.
Every controlled drawing must link part, assembly, requirement/product-definition sources and current build evidence.
Generic API scope is capability-bounded: unsupported or non-topological characteristics go to manual_finish instead of causing whole-drawing HOLD.
A PARTIAL/HOLD semantic build is evidence only and must never be promoted into current/<drawing_id> as a routine working drawing.
Registry status fields are declarative trace/readiness context only; live candidate/current PASS/HOLD is derived exclusively by reports/control/K01_DRAWING_CONTROL_CURRENT.json.
For candidates created after presentation-gate v2, semantic PASS alone is not publishable; presentation_status must start with PASS_.
